2026-10-21.title: October pull: 265 new entries from Instagram
2026-10-21.what_changed: New saves were pulled straight from Instagram's collection data (the old scroll-scraper missed most posts: it saw 12 of 31 in one collection). 2026-10-22.title: 7 parked dives promoted (45 curated)
